{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Now compute mean revenue of completed orders only
completed_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA and non-completed): {mean_revenue}")"}
